verdict.rationale: Brex's documentation shows no product-native way to schedule recurring jobs or workflows. The only recurring example is a Zapier recipe, a third-party automation platform the user would set up separately, so it earns no credit. Brex's AI review and audit agents and its auto-enforced policies run in response to transactions, not on a user-defined schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
